Possible-send crash stays unknown with reserved budget and resource fences; repeated restart/TTL never issues another request or false terminal.

Approval-wait SIGKILL expires in-memory login and old approval authority; fresh authenticated Owner approve is rejected and cannot restart an unknown driver.
Departed member, disabled/revoked account and stopped Thread remain denied across restart before creating any Attempt/resource/provider send.
Actual readonly SQLite HTTP submission fails closed with no durable partial message, Wake, outbox, execution or phantom success after restart.
Mixed legacy/threaded data remains isolated through SIGKILL and authenticated HTTP projection; production capability declarations remain closed.
